title: A significant source of nitrous oxide from recreational use in Ho Chi Minh City, a future Southeast Asian megacity in Vietnam
content:
Environ. Sci.: Atmos., 2026, 6,390-404
DOI: 10.1039/D5EA00083A, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Grant Forster, Michael Biggart, Ruth M. Doherty, Alex R. Baker, Alex Etchells, Graham Mills, To Thi Hien, Nguyen Doan Thien Chi, Duong Huu Huy, David Oram
This study uses in situ measurements N2O to identify a source from recreational use in Ho Chi Minh City, Vietnam. Emissions from this source are compatible to those from stationary energy sector and should be included in future emission inventories.
